evidence: A satisfying settlement can specify stationary grid-scale energy storage as the exclusive licensed field, exclude electric vehicles, set a 6% net-sales royalty and $250,000 annual minimum, require government-use rights and a U.S.-manufacturing plan, include grant and commercial drafting commitments, and cite and reveal PF2. A reasonable settlement based only on shared facts could leave these terms unresolved and fail multiple checks.
